facts.fact: The document states the Tanzania Statistical Master Plan Phase Two (TSMP II) has been under implementation since 2022/23 and will end in June 2027; it is dated to the document's publication date as it states the plan in force.

The fourth meeting of the TSMP II Steering Committee, chaired by the Ministry of Finance Permanent Secretary, met on 15 July 2026 and reviewed implementation for 2025/26, reporting 88.9% implementation since 2022/23, and approved the 2026/27 work plan and budget.
